therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Multimodality therapy (Leuprolide Acetate + Bicalutamide + Docetaxel + Prostatectomy + Radiation)
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Androgen deprivation therapy combined with chemotherapy, surgical resection, and radiation to metastatic sites
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Systemic androgen suppression, microtubule disruption, and local tumor control
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Men with newly diagnosed oligometastatic prostate cancer (<5 sites of metastases)

results.effect_size: 17 participants with PSA progression-free survival at 2 years
biomarker_changes: Median time to PSA recurrence: 31 months (95% CI: 25.2–32.3)
results.dose_information: Leuprolide 22.5mg IM every 3 months, Bicalutamide 50mg daily, Docetaxel 75 mg/m2 IV every 3 weeks up to 6 cycles
